name: Dispositional Middle
pattern: Clause[Theme Subject + active transitive-capable V + optional ease/manner modifier]

entry.name: Dispositional Middle
entry.pattern: Clause[Theme Subject + active transitive-capable V + optional ease/manner modifier]

1.definition: Presents a referent as having a disposition affecting how an action can be carried out on it.

examples.note: Constructed comparison. An eventive passive with a specific occasion, in contrast to the dispositional middle.

relatedConstructions.notes: This fabric washes well attributes a disposition with active verb forms. This fabric was washed at noon reports a particular event in the passive.
This fabric washes well invites an interpretation involving a washer. The door opened can simply report a change of state without invoking an implicit opener.

projection.target: The subject corresponds to the ordinary object, yet the verb is active. The default generic assessment contrasts with an event report such as This fabric was washed at noon.
projection.evidence: See the cited discussion and the constructed illustration.

curious.title: Things that wash well
curious.summary: A sentence with an ordinary verb can describe how an action can be carried out on something.
curious.body:
This fabric washes well describes the fabric, and the verb washes looks like any active verb. But the sentence is about a quality of the fabric: how an action can be carried out on it. The sentence suggests someone doing the washing.

Compare The fabric was washed at noon. That reports a particular event on a particular occasion, so it isn't a statement about the fabric's qualities.
curious.try: Think of an object around you and a verb for something done to it. Can you say how well it does under that action, as in This fabric washes well?

teacher.summary: Helps explain active-form clauses that describe a property of the subject, not an event, and contrast them with passives.
teacher.explain: The dispositional middle is a clause whose subject is the theme, with an active transitive-capable verb and an optional ease or manner modifier. It presents a referent as having a disposition affecting how an action can be carried out on it. This fabric washes well attributes a disposition with active verb forms; This fabric was washed at noon reports a particular event in the passive. This dictionary notes that This fabric washes well invites an interpretation involving a washer, unlike The door opened, which can simply report a change of state without an implicit opener.
teacher.terms: Sometimes called the middle construction, or simply the middle.

contrasts.note: An eventive passive with a specific occasion.
Can simply report a change of state without an implicit opener.

watch_for: A learner might read This fabric washes well as describing something the fabric does by itself.
A learner might treat This fabric washes well and This fabric was washed at noon as the same, though the first attributes a disposition and the second reports a particular event.
teacher.activity: Give students sentences about objects (the bread cuts easily, the tickets were sold yesterday) and ask them to sort them into disposition statements and event reports.
